meanings: to owe, to lack, (literary) to be deficient in, (bound form) yawn, to raise slightly (a part of one's body)
surname Qiang, gun, firearm, rifle, spear, thing with shape or function similar to a gun, to substitute for another person in a test, to knock, classifier for rifle shots, variant of 枪
(literary) to knock against (esp. to knock one's head on the ground in grief or rage), opposite in direction; contrary, to fight over, to rush, to scramble, to grab, to rob, to snatch
